_instructions.note: Keys starting with _ are skipped by the harness, not real nights.
_instructions.corpus_dir: Point --corpus-dir at the flat folder these filenames live in (e.g. ~/Documents/TestLogs) -- all paths below are bare filenames, no subfolders.
_instructions.expected_values_source: subs / settled_guide_rms / drops are copied directly from corpus-index.md's Imaging sessions table. rms_tolerance defaults to 0.02" if not given.
_instructions.invariants_caveat: expected_failed_invariants is empty for every night below -- run the harness once, review which invariant failures show up, and populate these once you've decided which are known/acceptable (e.g. 2026-06-05's mixed exposure lengths) vs. real regressions.
_instructions.meridian_verification_caveat: Meridian Flip Verification needs each night's location: the night's "location" if it has one, else "_default_location", both naming an entry in "_locations" (copied from the Imaging Log's locations). Every night is at 113 Pier except 2026-02-03 to 02-06 at Crawford. (Issue #338)
_instructions.new_nights_2026_10_08: 2026-08-09 to 2026-10-06 were added 2026-10-08 with expected values recorded from the analysis code's own output that day (not from corpus-index.md), as a regression baseline.
_instructions.recorded_values: tier_counts, recommendations and meridian_verification are recorded from the analysis code's own output with --record (Issue #338). Re-record only after a deliberate change, and review the diff.
